metadata.description: Comprehensive cultural and behavioral data for Belgium, Austria, Norway, Denmark, Ireland, Portugal — 25+ data points per country covering work culture, consumer behavior, social norms, startup ecosystem, digital behavior, daily routines, food culture, and cost of living in capital city.
